decisions.reason: As the current analytics standard and a close fit with the firm's e-commerce support capabilities, this plugin is likely to meet aspiration levels well enough to justify retention while the growing market reduces pressure to cut it.

Because Universal Analytics became obsolete, its results would likely fall clearly below aspiration levels and management would reallocate the released resources to more promising development and service work.

This interface plugin fits the firm's integration and customization strengths, and even if early results are uncertain, organizational slack and possible cross-selling value make continued testing more likely than withdrawal.
The SEO relaunch service is strongly aligned with the firm's core offer and was given dedicated presentation, suggesting performance likely meets aspirations or is promising enough to retain.
